segments.text: OpenAI just dropped an official plugin for Claude Code. Codex plugin for Claude Code lets you invoke OpenAI's Codeex model directly inside your Claude Code
terminal. Just had Claude write a massive feature? Run /codex review to have Codeex doublech checkck the work.
Want to go harder? Use adversarial review to make Codeex act like a ruthless senior engineer and aggressively pressure test your code before merging. Two rival AIs, one terminal.
